title: MZ Pixel Upscaling Plugin for RPG Maker MZ???

posts.author: Aker
posts.body:
Hiya. I wanted to bring something up because it has piqued my interest for some time. I know little about coding or making plugins, but I'm willing to try this if no one else will. I think an upscaling plugin similar to algorithms like xBRZ would be genuinely amazing for RPG Maker and it's kinda insane that we don't have anything like that in 2026. I'm aware that like one or two sprite zoom plugins exist, but that's just for sprites and doesn't do anything for tilesets and the like.
I think it would be a wonderful addition to plugins because as nice as pixelated games can look, upscaling on the other hand can make your own sprites and tiles look like drawings and I think that's a wonderful option for those who don't know how to draw and don't have the time, patience, desire or physical ability for learning it. Upscaling sprites externally makes them too big, so that's not even an option. If anybody has any suggestions or is up to the task, feel free to let me know please.
For those who are unaware, this is what it looks like. It blends pixels together to make them look like drawings rather than pixel art. It's a method that's typically used for modern retro gaming and I genuinely think it could do well as an alternative to those stuck making pixel art for whatever reason they may have. It's also a nice option for those who don't like looking at pixels, so it sorta acts like a stylized option in that regard. Here's one of my early test sprites and a generic comparison image.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Looks like a cheap posterize filter, and imo I don't find that very attractive. Especially in the emulator scene, to me it ruins the skillfully crafted art.
If someone were to use this as the base of their own game then maybe it can work, but if you are going to illustrate more traditionally, why fake it through posterize filters? Just draw, lol.
Anyways, maybe someone is interested. I'm not here to talk you down from the project - more options the better. Just voicing my opinion, I think that looks...not...great.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: xBRZ certainly does an amazing job of upscaling pixel art. I'm not aware of any implementation of it that will work in JavaScript, but perhaps you could find one by googling. I'm not sure how that would be integrated in the RPGMaker pipeline though.
